The Microphone Has Been Tested. The Signal Is Strong. The Structure Is Ready.
Adamawa is ready, and its message is clear: the political structure, leadership and grassroots network are firmly in place to support President Bola Ahmed Tinubu and all All Progressives Congress (APC) candidates in the 2027 general elections.
With Governor Ahmadu Umaru Fintiri providing leadership, direction and strategic coordination, the state is prepared to pursue a decisive victory. The commitment is firm, the objective is clear, and the target is 100% electoral victory across the board.
Achieving this goal requires sustained engagement, unity of purpose and disciplined organisation. Every stakeholder, coordinator and supporter has a role to play in taking the message to the people and translating commitment into votes.
At the centre of this mobilisation is the Adamawa Renewed Hope 226 Movement (ARH-226M), led by its Director-General, Professor Abdullahi Liman Tukur. It is a structured, coordinated, knowledge-driven and grassroots-focused political movement established to transform political support into organised electoral action.
Its reach extends across every level of the state’s political landscape:
* 4,104 Polling Units: Where every vote counts and community engagement must translate into electoral participation. * 226 Electoral Wards: Where grassroots mobilisation takes shape, relationships are strengthened and local priorities receive attention. * 21 Local Government Areas: Where leadership, coordination and stakeholder engagement connect the statewide mission with community action.
Through its 21 experienced LGA coordinators, clear leadership structures and effective mobilisation strategies, ARH-226M is prepared to reach communities, engage stakeholders and consolidate support for the APC from the polling units to the state level.
The task is to sustain a visible presence, listen to the people, communicate the Renewed Hope message clearly and encourage eligible voters to participate peacefully and confidently in the electoral process.
From community meetings to stakeholder consultations, every engagement must strengthen trust, widen participation and reinforce a shared commitment to victory. With consistent follow-through and cooperation across party structures, the movement can keep its mobilisation focused and responsive to local realities.
This coordinated effort will turn readiness into action, action into mobilisation and mobilisation into victory.
Adamawa is ready. The structure is in place. The mission is achievable.
One State. One Purpose. A Shared Commitment to Renewed Hope.
With Fintiri as the leader, Adamawa will deliver, Insha Allah!
